integrity: Every finite assertion is reproducible using the included checker and integer certificate; no external independent audit has been performed. Existence of unindexed equivalent results is an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the open-neighborhood complex of the 25-vertex quadratic-residue Paley graph; no assertion about homology representations, other Paley orders, or persistence. The homotopy proof uses explicit integer discrete-Morse reductions, not a formally independently certified computation.
title: Five-primary torsion and a Moore summand in the Paley-25 neighborhood complex
